shout.skycraft.animal_allegiance.desc: A Shout for help from the beasts of the wild, who come to fight in your defense.
shout.skycraft.aura_whisper.desc: Your Voice is not a shout, but a whisper, revealing the life forces of any and all.
shout.skycraft.become_ethereal.desc: The Thu'um reaches out to the Void, changing your form to one that cannot be harmed - or harm.
shout.skycraft.clear_skies.desc: Skyrim itself yields before the Thu'um, as you clear away fog and inclement weather.
shout.skycraft.disarm.desc: Shout defies steel, as you rip the weapon from an opponent's grasp.
shout.skycraft.dragonrend.desc: Your Voice lashes out at a dragon's very soul, forcing the beast to land.
shout.skycraft.elemental_fury.desc: The Thu'um imbues your arms with the speed of wind, allowing for faster weapon strikes.
shout.skycraft.fire_breath.desc: Inhale air, exhale flame, and behold the Thu'um as inferno.
shout.skycraft.frost_breath.desc: Your breath is winter, your Thu'um a blizzard.
shout.skycraft.kynes_peace.desc: The Voice soothes wild beasts, who lose their will to fight.
shout.skycraft.marked_for_death.desc: Speak, and let your Voice herald doom, as an opponent's armor is lowered and life force drained.
shout.skycraft.slow_time.desc: Shout at time, and command it to obey, slowing all around you.
shout.skycraft.storm_call.desc: A Shout to the skies, a cry to the clouds, that awakens the destructive force of the storm.
shout.skycraft.unrelenting_force.desc: Your Voice is raw power, pushing aside anything - or anyone - who stands in your path.
shout.skycraft.whirlwind_sprint.desc: The Thu'um rushes forward, carrying you in its wake with the speed of a tempest.
spell.skycraft.blizzard.desc: Hold to charge, then summon a freezing storm around you that does 25 points of frost damage per second for 12 seconds.
spell.skycraft.bound_battleaxe.desc: Creates a magic battleaxe for 120 seconds.
spell.skycraft.bound_bow.desc: Creates a magic bow for 120 seconds. Its arrows are conjured as you draw.
spell.skycraft.bound_sword.desc: Creates a magic sword for 120 seconds. Sheathe it to dispel it.
spell.skycraft.calm.desc: Creatures and people up to a moderate level won't fight for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.candlelight.desc: Creates a hovering light that follows the caster for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning that does 40 points of shock damage and then leaps to two more targets nearby.
spell.skycraft.conjure_dremora_lord.desc: Hold to charge, then summon a Dremora Lord for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.conjure_familiar.desc: Summons a spectral wolf to fight for you for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.conjure_flame_atronach.de: Summons a Flame Atronach for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.conjure_frost_atronach.de: Summons a Frost Atronach for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.conjure_storm_atronach.de: Summons a Storm Atronach for 60 seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
spell.skycraft.courage.desc: The ally you aim at (or your summoned allies) won't flee and fight harder for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.detect_life.desc: Nearby living creatures, but not the undead or constructs, can be seen through walls for 15 seconds.
spell.skycraft.ebonyflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 100 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.fear.desc: Creatures and people up to a moderate level flee from combat for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.fire_storm.desc: Hold to charge, then unleash a massive explosion of fire around you, doing 100 points of damage to nearby targets.
spell.skycraft.fireball.desc: A fiery explosion for 40 points of damage in a 4 block radius. Targets on fire take extra damage. Never harms the land.
spell.skycraft.firebolt.desc: A blast of fire that does 25 points of damage. Targets on fire take extra damage.
spell.skycraft.flames.desc: A gout of fire that does 8 points of fire damage per second. Targets on fire take extra damage.
spell.skycraft.frenzy.desc: Creatures and people in the target area attack anything nearby for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.frostbite.desc: A blast of cold that does 8 points of frost damage per second to Health and Stamina, and slows the target.
spell.skycraft.fury.desc: Creatures and people up to a low level will attack anything nearby for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.grand_healing.desc: Heals you and everyone nearby 200 points.
spell.skycraft.guardian_circle.desc: Hold to charge, then create a circle that heals allies inside 20 points per second and burns and repels the undead for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.harmony.desc: Hold to charge, then calm every creature and person around you for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.heal_other.desc: Heals the target 15 points per second. Doesn't work on the undead or on constructs.
spell.skycraft.healing.desc: Heals the caster 10 points per second.
spell.skycraft.ice_spike.desc: A spike of ice that does 25 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina, and slows the target.
spell.skycraft.ice_storm.desc: A freezing whirlwind that does 40 points of frost damage per second to Health and Stamina of everything it passes through.
spell.skycraft.icy_spear.desc: A spear of ice that does 60 points of frost damage to Health and Stamina.
spell.skycraft.incinerate.desc: A blast of fire that does 60 points of damage. Targets on fire take extra damage.
spell.skycraft.invisibility.desc: Caster is invisible for 30 seconds. Attacking ends the effect.
spell.skycraft.ironflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 80 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.lesser_ward.desc: While held, a ward in front of you absorbs up to 40 points of spell damage.
spell.skycraft.lightning_bolt.desc: A bolt of lightning that does 25 points of shock damage to Health and half to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.lightning_storm.desc: Hold to charge, then call down a storm of lightning where you aim for 150 points of shock damage.
spell.skycraft.mass_paralysis.desc: Hold to charge, then paralyze every creature in the target area for 15 seconds.
spell.skycraft.mayhem.desc: Hold to charge, then drive every creature and person around you into a frenzy for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.muffle.desc: You move more quietly and are harder to detect for 180 seconds.
spell.skycraft.oakflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 40 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.pacify.desc: Creatures and people in the target area won't fight for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.paralyze.desc: Targets that fail to resist are paralyzed for 10 seconds.
spell.skycraft.raise_zombie.desc: Raises a zombie from the earth where you aim, to fight for you for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.rally.desc: Allies around you won't flee and fight harder for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.soul_trap.desc: If the target dies within 60 seconds, its soul fills an empty soul gem you carry.
spell.skycraft.sparks.desc: Lightning that does 8 points of shock damage per second to Health, and half that to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.stoneflesh.desc: Improves the caster's armor rating by 60 points for 60 seconds.
spell.skycraft.thunderbolt.desc: A thunderbolt that does 60 points of shock damage to Health and half to Magicka.
spell.skycraft.transmute.desc: Transmutes one piece of iron (ingot, raw iron or ore) you carry into gold.
spell.skycraft.turn_lesser_undead.desc: Weak undead flee from you for 30 seconds.
spell.skycraft.waterbreathing.desc: You can breathe underwater for 60 seconds.
